expectedBehavior: Inspect the workload-set and official iOS manifest packages without installing them to identify the actual manifest package, workload ID, pack graph, and host aliases.
observedBehavior: The workload set maps Microsoft.NET.Sdk.iOS to 26.5.10301/10.0.100. Microsoft.NET.Sdk.iOS.Manifest-10.0.100 26.5.10301 exposes workload ID ios and Windows SDK aliases only; no Linux host mapping was observed.
limitations: Package inspection does not establish resolver precedence or lifecycle behavior.
The package graph includes transitive runtime/toolchain work not yet inventoried.
No project-owned manifest has been generated or installed.
nextDecision: M1 must test whether a distinct project manifest can coexist with this official ios definition; otherwise evaluate a managed replacement under an ADR.

commands.command: Download and inspect Microsoft.NET.Workloads.10.0.300 10.302.0 and Microsoft.NET.Sdk.iOS.Manifest-10.0.100 26.5.10301 with unzip
